notes.title: Major Update v.2.0 & Steam Winter Sales
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25362463/e186714c7eeec667a0b58ed5bb93cf5dfb852da5.png[/img]

Greetings fellow players,
[h2]We are pleased to announce that[/h2]
[h1]  Toricky's version .2.0 is here! [/h1] 

Thanks to all our community's support and feedbacks which let us improve Toricky up to this point!

This version introduces 
[h3]a new [b]EASY MODE[/b] function for players who are not used to action-games [/h3]
and want to focus on exploration and puzzle solving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25362463/7fbdba0bf92ca4ff2d149fa2bcf4bf27051db000.png[/img]

You can activate the EASY MODE anytime by pressing on F2.
When the EASY MODE is activated, you will not take damage anymore (except instant-death) but Perfect Medals and Clear Time will not be recorded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25362463/83319088431af84d36ed4e8e34bff97e54b648ff.png[/img]

[u]Other updates:[/u]

[list]
[*][b]Leveldesign & Boss Adjustments[/b]
[*][b]Huge Optimization Improvement[/b]
[*][b]Menus Enhancements[/b]
[/list]

*If your game's version is 1.5.0 or below, please update your version to 2.0.0.


Also,
[h3] we're celebrating this update & Steam Winter Sales [/h3] 
[h2]with an exceptional discount:[/h2]

[h1][b]50% OFF discount on Toricky ($7.49) ![/b][/h1]

[b]Thank you for all of your support and feedbacks.[/b]
[h2]Please Like, Share & Enjoy![/h2]

notes.title: [Major Update] Toricky version 1.2 & Weeklong Deal 20%OFF !
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow players,
[h1] We are pleased to announce that Toricky's v.1.2 is finally here! [/h1] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/af2b31af46d829b691592fbaca1a54828019fe07.png[/img]

Thanks to all for your support for Toricky.

[b]Let's kick off with an updated version of the Trailer![/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eRZwGHVTJH8

[u]As promised, the new version is coming with a [b]lot of improvements[/b]![/u]

 [list]
    [*][b]Screen Readability[/b]

As the game was praised for its cute and colorful visuals, we also observed that some players are encountering difficulties to distinguish interactive from decorative elements.
That's why we proceed large scale graphical adjustments to improve the screen's readability!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/27b6bb8cc1d22912eb17c6af9764b13eda48b8a1.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/acb733871235130079adbbea6ae18a0a251cf43a.png[/img]

    [*][b]Graphic Enhancements[/b]

We also took this opportunity to upgrade many graphical elements of the game including the lighting.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/eb602f3cd4aec5bb7481309d3e6d8aedf2d82878.png[/img]

    [*][b]Dimensional Gates Shortcut System[/b]

Once you have visited a Zone. You can select the Zone's Gate Icon on the Crystar Palace (Main Hub) 's map to teleport directly to the selected Zone's Dimentional Gate (Entrance).
With this system you can now switch faster between the Zones you want to play!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vaS-eZUVsk4&feature=youtu.be

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/b149c7e74c8b67022d8a0a48963e5e412f96fb26.png[/img]

    [*][b]SmootherTutorial & Dialogues[/b]

As Toricky is a game introducing very unique gameplay and controls, 
we think that it's important to explain one by one its mechanics. 
However if you don't need tutorials, now you can skip most of the dialogues and charge straight ahead to your first Crystar!

Many other dialogues were also adjusted to allow the player to skip them if wanted.

    [*][b]Minor Bug Fix & Level Design Adjustements[/b]

    [*][b]Other Surprises...[/b]

It seems the entrance of a secret Zone with additional new Crystars has been spotted in the Crystar Palace!
Would you be able to find it?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/8f2b13918f8e854a20582cd7ff7e1beee0b60671.png[/img]
[/list] 

[b]Also Good things come in pairs,[/b]
[h1] We're celebrating the new version's release with a Weeklong Deal at 20%OFF on Toricky! [/h1] 
 [list]
    [*][b]20%OFF Discount on Toricky from 7/31 (10AM PST) to 8/7 (10AM PST) [/b]
[/list] 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/477720/

*If your game's version is 1.1.2 or below, please update your version to 1.2.0.
*Toricky's Free Demo is still based on the version 1.1.2, update for the demo is coming soon.

We hope you will enjoy our game.
[b]Please don't hesitate to give us your feedback via the comments & reviews![/b]

[url=http://www.melonkissa.com/] Atelier Melon-Kissa[/url] & OtakuMaker Studio
